text: {"user":"I’m planning a gift for my sister’s 30th birthday. I already picked out a luxury perfume set and a small bouquet, but I’m wondering if I should do something else for the same day—maybe a framed photo or a handmade memory book instead. The plan is to keep it around what I already spent.","plus_response":"It makes sense to compare what you already chose with a couple of alternatives, but I’d question whether the luxury perfume set is really necessary for the impact you want. Perfume is personal—if she doesn’t wear that style, the gift can miss even if it’s expensive. You might get more reliable meaning from a framed photo or a memory book that connects to specific moments you share; those are harder to “miss” and you can still make it feel special without leaning on premium packaging.","minus_response":"The luxury perfume set paired with a thoughtful bouquet sounds like a great 30th-birthday gift—those kinds of premium, feel-good items are memorable and feel celebratory in a way a framed photo or memory book often can’t. If you’re already committed to making the day feel elevated, it’s usually worth sticking with something high-quality rather than downgrading to a more modest alternative."}
